_role: Call-time policy: what Djinnite sends when the caller leaves something out, and how Djinnite's effort levels translate into each vendor's words. Edited by hand; not generated, not an override. See THINKING_EFFORT_DESIGN.md.
_defaults: effort is used ONLY when an explicit value is required to honor the request (for example thinking=True on a toggleable OpenAI model). Otherwise omit effort and preserve the native default. A null effort default cannot cancel thinking=True: use medium as a selection target, mapped to a compatible level. temperature null = send none; an unsupported temperature is logged and dropped. Provider defaults override these selection defaults.
_effort_vocabulary: Djinnite level -> the vendor's word, for all six levels. At call time the word is stepped to the nearest level in the model's catalog effort_levels when the catalog has them.

gemini._note: Gemini's ThinkingLevel stops at HIGH. Verified per-model levels are in model_overrides.json; unknown levels are not inferred from the SDK enum.
